settings.title: Settings
settings.claimExpiryHint: A claimed order is freed for others this long after its holder last worked on it.

sla.title: SLA per stage (minutes)
sla.hint: Flag orders that stay longer than this in a stage. Leave empty for no limit.

piiRetention.label: Keep customer details (days)
piiRetention.hint: Leave empty to keep them forever. Between 30 and 3650 days.

settings.qaMustDifferFromPacker: QA must be done by someone other than the packer

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.clearConfirm: Clear the {name}? The integration stops working until a new value is added.
integrations.writeOnly: Stored encrypted. Nobody can view it after saving, so keep your own copy if you need one.
integrations.urlMoveBody: The new address is on a different server. Saving it removes the saved {secrets}, so they're never sent there. Add them again for the new address.
integrations.savedKeysCleared: Saved. The keys for the old address were removed: add them for the new one.
integrations.testHint: Checks the saved store URL and keys.
integrations.testOk: Connected. The store uses {weight} for weight and {dimension} for dimensions.

webhook.title: Webhooks
webhook.intro: Webhooks bring new and changed orders in within seconds. Sync still polls if they stop.
webhook.step1: In WordPress, open WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → Webhooks and add a webhook.
webhook.step2: Status Active, topic “Order created”, API version “WP REST API Integration v3”.
webhook.step3: Delivery URL: the one above. Secret: the webhook secret saved here.
webhook.step4: Add a second webhook the same way with the topic “Order updated”.

integrations.sendTestEmailHint: Sends to your own address with the saved sender and key.
integrations.testEmailLogged: Resend isn't set up, so the email to {to} was written to the server log instead of sent.

priorityRules.title: Priority rules
priorityRules.intro: An order gets the highest level among the enabled rules it matches, or Normal if none match. The order of this list is only for reading it.
priorityRules.deleteBody: Open orders that only matched this rule go back to the level of the remaining rules.
priorityRules.name: Name
priorityRules.empty: No rules yet: every order is Normal.
priorityRules.containsHint: Ignores upper and lower case, e.g. Express.

summary.lineItem: Has a line with {match, select, sku {SKU} other {name}} {value}
summary.orderAge: Ordered {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} ago or more

priorityRules.created: Rule “{name}” added. Open orders were re-prioritized.
priorityRules.updated: Rule “{name}” saved. Open orders were re-prioritized.
priorityRules.deleted: Rule “{name}” deleted. Open orders were re-prioritized.

queue.externalChange: Changed in the store after import

order.title: Order #{number}
order.unclaimed: Nobody is working on this order.
order.forceHint: Skips every check. The reason is kept in the order's history.
order.takeOverBody: {name} is working on this order. Taking it over moves the claim to you.

history.title: History
history.empty: Nothing has happened to this order yet.

externalChange.title: Changed in the store
externalChange.detected: WooCommerce changed this order {time}. Nothing has been changed here yet.
externalChange.statusNote: Status changes are handled with Cancel / Resume, not Apply.
externalChange.applied: Applied the store's changes to order {number}.
externalChange.dismissed: Dismissed the store's changes on order {number}.

notes.title: Notes
notes.empty: No notes on this order yet.
notes.customerVisibleHint: WooCommerce emails it to the customer when the order ships. Leave it off for notes meant for the team.
notes.deleteBody: It is removed for everyone. This can't be undone.

page.title: Sync
page.intro: Orders sync on a schedule and from store webhooks. Use these buttons to run a sync right away.
page.queued: Sync queued. It shows in the log when the worker starts it.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed this. Reload and try again.

box.nameTaken: A box with this name already exists.
box.inUse: This box is used by a package and can only be archived.

field.urlCredentials: Leave the username and password out of the address; enter keys in the fields below.
field.usState: Use the 2-letter state code, e.g. TX.
field.emailFrom: Use an address like no-reply@example.com or Woolrus '<'no-reply@example.com>.

settings.encryptionKeyMissing: Secrets can't be saved: the server's encryption key is missing or invalid. Ask whoever runs the server to set SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

workflow.illegalTransition: That move isn't allowed from the order's current status.
workflow.stale: This order changed since you loaded it. It has been refreshed; check it and try again.
workflow.claimRequired: Claim this order before completing the stage.
workflow.notClaimable: This order can't be claimed in its current status.
workflow.takeOverConfirm: Confirm that you want to take this order over.
workflow.claimManyFailed: Some orders couldn't be claimed, so none were.

gate.lineOutOfStock: {line} is out of stock. Void it or pick a substitute first.
gate.packageNoBox: Package {package} needs a box or all three dimensions.
gate.packageNotVerified: Package {package} has {count} item(s) not yet verified.
gate.packageNoRate: Package {package} needs exactly one selected rate.
gate.packageLiveLabel: Package {package} has a label that must be voided first.

sync.unauthorized: WooCommerce refused the consumer key or secret. Check them in Settings → Integrations.
sync.unreachable: WooCommerce couldn't be reached. Check the store URL and that the store is up.
sync.notWooCommerce: That URL doesn't look like a WooCommerce store (no REST API v3 found).
sync.rateLimited: WooCommerce is limiting requests. Sync will try again shortly.
sync.badResponse: WooCommerce sent a response Woolrus couldn't read.
sync.notConfigured: WooCommerce isn't set up yet. Add the store URL and keys in Settings → Integrations.
sync.importFailed: The order couldn't be saved. Sync will try it again on the next run.
sync.notFlagged: This order has no store change to review. It has been refreshed.
sync.cannotApply: This store change can't be applied without undoing work on the floor.

unmet.belowPicked: {line}: the store wants {to}, but {picked} are already picked.
unmet.belowPacked: {line}: the store wants {to}, but {packed} are already packed.
unmet.lineVoided: {line} has voided units. Resolve the void before lowering the quantity.
unmet.removedStarted: {line} was removed in the store but is already picked or packed. Unpack or unpick it first.
unmet.removedHasRecords: {line} was removed in the store but has notes, issues or voids on it.
unmet.pastPacking: {line}: the order is already past Packing, so an added or larger line would ship without being picked and packed. Force it back to Packing first, or dismiss.

email.unauthorized: Resend refused the API key. Check it in Settings → Integrations.
email.rejected: Resend refused the email. Check the sender address and that its domain is verified in Resend.
email.unavailable: Resend couldn't be reached. Try again in a minute.

users.lastAdmin: This would leave no active Admin. Make someone else an Admin first.
users.self: You can't deactivate yourself or remove your own Admin role.
users.alreadyExists: Someone with this email already has an account.
users.pinWeak: Too easy to guess: avoid repeated digits and runs like 123456.

invitations.pending: This email already has a pending invitation. Resend or revoke it instead.
invitations.notOpen: This invitation was already accepted or revoked.

auth.deactivated: Your account is deactivated. Ask an admin to reactivate it.
auth.linkInvalid: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.

stations.nameTaken: There's already a station with that name.
stations.personalOnly: Register a station from your own sign-in, not from a station.

station.locked: This station is locked. Unlock it to continue.
station.unknown: This device is no longer a station.
station.pinLocked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again at {until, time, short}.
station.notStation: Only a station can be locked.

notes.empty: Write something in the note first.
notes.notAuthor: Only the note's author or an admin can change it.
notes.targetMismatch: That line, package or issue isn't on this order.

test.subject: Woolrus test email

users.title: Users

users.deactivateBody: They'll be signed out everywhere at once and can't sign back in until reactivated.
users.pinHelp: 6 digits. Avoid repeated digits and runs like 123456.
users.generatedPin: Give {name} this PIN now. It won't be shown again.
users.badgeOnce: This code is shown only now. Print the badge before you close this.

invitations.revokeBody: They won't be able to sign in with it. You can invite them again later.

station.prompt: Tap your name and enter your PIN, or scan your badge.
station.noTiles: Nobody has a PIN yet. Scan your badge, or ask an admin to set your PIN.

stations.title: Stations
stations.name: Name
stations.registerBody: You'll be signed out on this device, and it will show the station lock screen. Staff then unlock it with their PIN or badge.
stations.revokeBody: The device goes back to the sign-in page, and whoever is on it is locked out.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.checkEmail: Check your email for a sign-in link.
